facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's semi-annual report on the Domestic Revenue Mobilisation Strategy says that by 31 December 2024 NITA-U had made achievements including 'the rollout of an e-Government Strategy' and rated performance good, measured against no target of that strategy.

note: Revenue-strategy monitoring report (the Domestic Revenue Mobilisation Strategy is not a digital strategy); the e-Government Strategy is mentioned in one line with no scope, adopter or period, so class is left empty.
